title: Printed magazine covers with a large white 'Still.' wordmark over a moody chair-and-table photo
whatItIs: Overlapping printed covers on a dark rope net showing a warm, grainy interior photograph of walnut table and leather chairs, with a big white geometric sans 'Still.' at the top.
whatItMeans: Quiet and tactile; the full-stop and calm photo say slowness.
techniques: Set a huge white wordmark over a moody photo.
Use a full stop as part of the name.
Show covers overlapping on a dark surface.

vocabulary.definition: A masthead set large on a cover.
Visible texture from printing on paper.
Copies fanned on top of each other.
A name that ends with a full stop.
